articles.title: Coachella will continue streaming on YouTube through 2026
articles.summary: YouTube and Coachella organizers Goldenvoice renewed their exclusive partnership through 2026. That means fans all over the world will be able to stream the annual festival for free for another few more years.
articles.body: Can’t fly to California for Coachella? No problem. You’ll still be able to stream the annual arts and music festival live from the comfort of your own home for at least another few years. YouTube and Coachella organizers Goldenvoice announced on YouTube’s official blog that they’ve renewed their exclusive partnership through 2026. As a result, fans around the world will continue to stream the festival live for free from YouTube as well as watch on-demand videos of performances. “Our partnership with YouTube brings Coachella to everyone around the world,” said Goldenvoice president Paul Tollett. “The 2023 lineup sees performers from Brazil, France, Iceland, India, Jamaica, Nigeria, Puerto Rico, South Korea, Spain, and beyond, and bringing international fans closer to their hometown artists is important to our team.” For this year’s event, viewers will also be able to watch behind-the-scenes content on YouTube Shorts and talk to other fans through Live Chat. There will also be livestream and playlist integrations between YouTube and YouTube Music and on-site activations with YouTube creators and artists. Fans can buy Coachella and artist merchandise through YouTube Shopping, while YouTube Premium subscribers will be able to access exclusive content. This is the 11th year Coachella’s been available to stream live on YouTube. YouTube first became the exclusive livestreaming home of Coachella after signing an agreement with Goldenvoice in 2011, reports Billboard. They last renewed their partnership in 2018 for three years, though the festival was postponed in 2020 and 2021 due to the pandemic. Coachella will take place this year during the following two weekends: April 14th through 16th and April 21st through 23rd. Performers include the likes of Bad Bunny, Frank Ocean, Blackpink, Björk, Gorillaz, The Chemical Brothers, Blondie, Charli XCX, and more.

articles.title: Escolas e Prefeitura do Rio anunciam 15 escolas no Grupo Especial | G1
articles.standfirst: Gabriel David e o prefeito Eduardo Cavaliere anunciaram o acordo nesta quinta-feira (9). Em 2027, carnaval segue com 12 desfiles, com 2 acessos da série Ouro e uma rebaixada.
articles.summary: Gabriel David e o prefeito Eduardo Cavaliere anunciaram o acordo nesta quinta-feira (9). Em 2027, carnaval segue com 12 desfiles, com 2 acessos da série Ouro e uma rebaixada.
articles.body:
Representantes da Liesa e da Prefeitura do Rio informaram nesta quinta-feira (9) que chegaram a um acordo para que o Grupo Especial do carnaval do Rio tenha 15 escolas. O aumento no número de agremiações de 12 para 15, entretanto, será gradativo e, em 2027, o Grupo Especial segue com o mesmo número de 2026.

A informação foi confirmada pelo presidente da Liesa, Gabriel David, e pelo prefeito do Rio, Eduardo Cavaliere, que falaram com a imprensa.

"A gente chega num acordo de um carnaval de 15 escolas, mas que ele seja feito dentro do regulamento para que aos poucos isso aconteça, progressivamente", disse Cavaliere.

Representantes das escolas se reuniram ao longo da tarde e definiram a fórmula gradual para o aumento. TV Globo apurou que em 2027 o carnaval segue com 12 escolas - duas agremiações subirão da Série Ouro para 2028 e uma vai cair. O sistema será gradual até 2030. O sorteio para definir que dia será cada desfile está previsto para a próxima semana.

"Isso vai demandar uma noite de desfile com 5 escolas. Isso vai demandar mudança de regulamento, e essa decisão compete a Liesa. Uma decisão técnica das escolas e isso eles vão avançar nesse caminho. O papel da prefeitura foi garantir a estrutura financeira para isso, logística, infra-estrutura. Mesmo com a prefeitura garantindo, as escolas precisam de um tempo pra se preparar e planejar", acrescentou.

"As escolas entendem que é viável esse carnaval de 15 escolas, mas a gente entende que é necessário um preparo para isso. A gente vai fazer isso de uma forma gradual. Agora a gente está na discussão exatamente de como isso vai ser feito e vai fazer esse anúncio ainda no dia de hoje", disse Gabriel David. "A gente tem obstáculos estruturais, competitivos, que fazem que essa forma gradual seja a mais prudente".

articles.title: Série Ouro: Jacarezinho, São Clemente e Inocentes estão de volta | G1
articles.standfirst: De acordo com a Liga RJ, a recomposição da Série Ouro segue orientação do prefeito do Rio, Eduardo Cavaliere, que indicou publicamente a necessidade de inclusão de mais três escolas no grupo.
articles.summary: De acordo com a Liga RJ, a recomposição da Série Ouro segue orientação do prefeito do Rio, Eduardo Cavaliere, que indicou publicamente a necessidade de inclusão de mais três escola
articles.body:
Comissão de frente da Unidos do Jacarezinho — Foto: Clara Coiote/Riotur

A Liga RJ anunciou o retorno de três escolas para a série Ouro: Unidos do Jacarezinho, São Clemente e Inocentes de Belford Roxo. O anúncio ocorreu no mesmo dia em que a Liesa, que organiza o Grupo Especial, anunciou aumento gradativo no número de suas escolas para 15 agremiações até 2030.

De acordo com a Liga RJ, a recomposição da Série Ouro segue orientação do prefeito do Rio, Eduardo Cavaliere, que indicou publicamente a necessidade de inclusão de mais três escolas no grupo. A Liga afirma que a diretriz foi acatada integralmente, em alinhamento com o compromisso firmado com o poder público e com as próprias agremiações.

Nesse contexto, foi definida a permanência da Unidos do Jacarezinho na Série Ouro. A escola enfrentou dois incêndios durante o ciclo carnavalesco de 2026 — um em seu barracão e outro na quadra —, o que comprometeu sua estrutura e preparação. Segundo a Liga RJ, a decisão foi unânime e considerada um gesto de solidariedade e respeito à comunidade da escola.

Além disso, foram aprovados convites para a entrada de três agremiações: a Inocentes de Belford Roxo, uma das fundadoras da Liga RJ, e a São Clemente, fundadora da Liga Independente das Escolas de Samba do Rio de Janeiro (Lierj). A decisão já foi formalizada junto à Riotur.

A Inocentes de Belford Roxo caiu da Série Ouro para a Série Prata no carnaval de 2026 e São Clemente caiu da Série Ouro em 2025.

A entidade também reforçou a necessidade de avanços por parte da Riotur na resolução de demandas antigas das escolas, especialmente aquelas relacionadas ao uso do espaço público e do Sambódromo, consideradas essenciais para a realização dos desfiles.

Em texto em suas redes sociais, a Liga RJ afirmou que as decisões refletem a vontade coletiva das escolas da Série Ouro e ressaltou o compromisso com a organização do carnaval e a busca pela excelência do espetáculo.

articles.title: Taylor Swift shocks fans with surprise announcement: ‘I’ve been impatiently waiting to tell you’
articles.summary: The Grammy winner made the announcement via her website on Tuesday.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift surprised fans with the announcement of a new song titled “Patient Zero” and released three CD variations of the track for pre-order on her website.

The CDs featuring different photos of Swift in black outfits with colored trims are available for $3.99 each while supplies last.

It is unclear whether “Patient Zero” will lead to a new album or remain a standalone solo track, following Swift’s last album release in October 2025.

Taylor Swift shocked fans with a surprise announcement Tuesday, revealing she's releasing a new song titled "Patient Zero."

"I've been impatiently waiting to tell you that my brand new single 'Patient Zero' will be out on September 25 (!!!!!!!!!!!!)," the Grammy winner wrote via Instagram , adding that it's "available to pre-order now" on her website for 24 hours.

Following the announcement, the "Bad Blood" singer released three CD variations of the track, including a piano version and an acoustic version, for pre-order on the site.

The front covers of the CDs featured three different photos of Swift, 36, donning different black-colored outfits, with additional pics of the pop star on the back cover. Each cover also featured different-colored trims, including sparkly black, orange and blue.

Fans can pre-order the CDs for $3.99 each while supplies last.

Swift announced the track after teasing fans with another countdown timer on her website — this time with a similar aesthetic to her "The Life of a Showgirl" album .

She also hinted at the secret by decorating her page with what appeared to be a satin red curtain background bordered with gold show-stopping sparkles.

It's unclear whether "Patient Zero" will lead to a new album or serve as a standalone solo track. Swift's last album, "The Life of a Showgirl," was released on Oct. 3, 2025.

The "Lover" songstress announced her 12th studio album on her now-husband Travis Kelce's podcast, "New Heights," that August, revealing a vinyl with an orange and green color scheme.

The12-track album included the tracks "The Fate of Ophelia," "Elizabeth Taylor," "Opalite," "Father Figure," "Eldest Daughter," "Ruin the Friendship," "Actually Romantic," "Wi$h Li$t," "Wood," "CANCELLED!," "Honey," and "The Life of a Showgirl."

Several tracks were famously dedicated to her romance with Kelce , including the song about his "manhood" titled "Wood" and "Wi$h Li$t," which hears her sing about finding a loyal companion.

Swift also pulled out all the stops for the album, releasing several limited-edition vinyls at the time.

Swift and the Kansas City Chiefs star, 36, got engaged in August 2025 after two years of dating.

"Your English teacher and your gym teacher are getting married," they captioned photos from the romantic proposal.

Page Six reported the couple hosted a star-studded wedding ceremony in front of their family and friends at Madison Square Garden July 3.

The lavish nuptials , attended by celebrities such as Gigi Hadid and Selena Gomez, were officiated by Adam Sandler , with Swift's brother, Austin, as the "Man of Honor" and Kelce's brother, Jason, as the best man.

The duo briefly enjoyed their life as newlyweds out of the spotlight ahead of Kelce gearing up for his 2026-27 NFL season with the Chiefs.

They officially broke cover for a date night at the Ambassadors Clubhouse New York Sept. 6, with the Super Bowl champ tenderly placing his hand on his wife's back as they made their way into the Big Apple hot spot in their coordinated satin outfits.

Kelce returned to the field for the Chiefs vs. Denver Broncos match Sept. 14, with Swift cheering alongside Tom Cruise in a private suite.

The "Blank Space" singer also proudly watched as Kelce made his first touchdown of the season at the Chiefs vs. Indianapolis Colts match in Missouri over the weekend.

Swift leaped with excitement, appearing to say "That's my husband!" while pointing to her wedding ring.

An insider told Page Six that the newlyweds were residing at Kelce's Kansas City home during the NFL season, but would likely jump around to Swift's various properties, including in NYC, California and Tennessee, throughout the year.

The duo also purchased a ritzy new Ohio mansion , where Kelce grew up.

articles.title: Companhia de teatro abre vagas para curso gratuito em Tatuí | G1
articles.standfirst: Formação terá início em 10 de outubro e segue até 20 de dezembro, aos sábados, com 60 horas de atividades. Não é necessário ter experiência anterior em teatro para participar.
articles.summary: O curso de teatro gratuito em Tatuí da Dupla Companhia oferece 30 vagas para iniciantes, com aulas aos sábados e foco em inclusão social e diversidade.
articles.body:
Curso livre de teatro está com inscrições abertas em Tatuí (SP) — Foto: Lucas Gonzaga

A Dupla Companhia está com inscrições abertas para um Curso Livre de Teatro gratuito, em Tatuí (SP). A formação terá início em 10 de outubro e segue até 20 de dezembro, com 60 horas de atividades e até 30 vagas disponíveis. As inscrições devem ser feitas pelo formulário online .

As aulas serão realizadas presencialmente aos sábados, das 10h às 13h, no Centro de Difusão, Criação e Produção Cultural da companhia, no bairro Doutor Laurindo. Também estão previstas atividades formativas complementares.

Conforme a companhia, não é necessário ter experiência anterior em teatro para participar. O curso é voltado a pessoas interessadas em conhecer ou aprofundar conhecimentos nas artes da cena.

Durante a formação, os participantes terão contato com jogos teatrais, improvisação, interpretação, expressão corporal, voz, memória e dramaturgia. A proposta é investigar as relações entre teatro, memória e identidade, temas presentes no trabalho da companhia.

Ao longo do curso, os alunos também vão participar da criação de um experimento cênico coletivo. O resultado será apresentado gratuitamente à comunidade em duas apresentações no espaço da companhia, ambas com interpretação em Libras.

Segundo a organização, pelo menos 50% das vagas serão destinadas prioritariamente a estudantes da rede pública, moradores de bairros periféricos de Tatuí e pessoas de grupos historicamente minorizados no acesso à cultura, como mulheres, pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

A seleção levará em consideração as informações apresentadas no formulário de inscrição, as cartas de interesse, a disponibilidade para acompanhar as atividades e os critérios de democratização do acesso previstos no projeto.

O projeto do curso foi contemplado pela Política Nacional Aldir Blanc de Fomento à Cultura, por meio da Secretaria de Esporte, Cultura, Turismo e Lazer da Estância Turística de Tatuí, do Ministério da Cultura e do Governo Federal.

articles.title: Seu Jorge e Trio Mocotó ajudam Paulo Ricardo a encarar Marvin Gaye em 'Sangue bom', versão de 'What's going on' | G1
articles.body:
Capa do single 'Sangue bom', de Paulo Ricardo com Seu Jorge — Foto: Arte de Speto

♬ Pedra fundamental da soul music dos anos 1970, o álbum “What’s going on” se tornou marco instantâneo da discografia do cantor e compositor norte-americano Marvin Gaye (2 de abril de 1939 – 1º de abril de 1984), ao ser lançado em maio de 1971, por captar as tensões sociais dos Estados Unidos.

Antes mesmo do álbum, a música-título “What’s going on” fez barulho ao ser apresentada em 10 de janeiro de 1971 em single que antecedeu o LP. Parceria de Gaye com Al Cleveland (1930 – 1996) e Renaldo Obie Benson (1936 – 2005), a música “What’s going on” se tornou um hino contra a Guerra do Vietnã e contra o preconceito racial em ebulição nos EUA. Com uma música, Gaye traduziu todo o estado de ansiedade, fervura e inquietação de um país.

É essa música, repleta de consciência social, que ressurge 55 anos após o lançamento na voz de Paulo Ricardo em versão em português intitulada “Sangue bom” e lançada em single hoje, quarta-feira, 23 de setembro, dia em que o cantor, compositor e músico carioca faz 64 anos.

Avalizada e autorizada pelos herdeiros de Marvin Gaye, a letra em português de Paulo Ricardo aborda a violência contra mulheres e crianças, em tempos de intolerância e radicalismo, e consegue captar um pouco do sentimento dos versos originais de “What’s going on”, sem ser uma tradução.

Embora seja cantor identificado com o universo do pop rock no imaginário nacional por ter sido projetado como vocalista da banda RPM nos anos 1980, sem ter tradição no canto do soul, Paulo Ricardo se cercou de artistas que transitam pelo universo do soul à moda brasileira.

A simples presença de Seu Jorge – cuja voz aveludada carrega toda uma ancestralidade afro-brasileira – contribui para conferir certa legitimidade ao single editado por Paulo Ricardo com capa que expõe obra criada por Speto, artista visual ligado ao grafite e à cultura urbana.

Seu Jorge é grande cantor associado ao samba-rock, gênero formatado pelo Trio Mocotó na virada dos anos 1960 para a década de 1970. Dois ritmistas do Trio Mocotó, João Parahyba (timbales) e Nereu Gargalo (pandeiro), foram arregimentados para a gravação de “Sangue bom”, feita com produção musical do guitarrista Waldo Denuzzo.

Com sopros proeminentes, a sonoridade do single “Sangue bom” é calorosa, mas o groove da gravação poderia ter ficado mais evidenciado na mixagem, já que a intenção foi trazer o standard de Marvin Gaye para o universo rítmico brasileiro.

De toda forma, “Sangue bom” sobressai entre os recentes lançamentos fonográficos de Paulo Ricardo com apuro perceptível já na capa do single. Seu Jorge e os músicos do Trio Mocotó ajudaram o cantor a encarar o hino de Marvin Gaye em gravação bem produzida que consegue escapar por um triz do risco da diluição.

Paulo Ricardo (à esquerda) canta com Seu Jorge uma inédita versão em português da música mais famosa de Marvin Gaye (1939 –1984) — Foto: Bella Pinheiro / Divulgação

articles.body: Mollywood actor Vinu Mohan and Vidya were a popular couple among Malayalam audiences. They appeared together in films and stage shows. Their social media presence also made them familiar to their followers.Vinu Mohan and actress Vidya have now reportedly divorced after 13 years of marriage as reported by multiple sites such as Manorama Online, Kerala Kaumudi. The couple got married in 2013 after falling in love through their association with cinema.The couple had regularly shared photographs and videos together on social media. Their posts received considerable attention from fans. However, their absence from each other's social media posts in recent months had led to speculation about their relationship.Vinu Mohan and Vidya's marriageVinu Mohan and Vidya got married in 2013. Their relationship reportedly began through their connection with the film industry. The couple later received the support of their families before getting married.For several years, Vinu Mohan and Vidya remained a familiar pair among Malayalam entertainment audiences. They appeared together at various events and stage shows. Their marriage lasted for 13 years. Reports about their divorce have now emerged, although the exact circumstances surrounding their separation have not been publicly disclosed.Social media activity sparks speculationVinu Mohan had removed photographs featuring Vidya from his Instagram page. Vidya, meanwhile, still has photographs of the couple together on her Instagram account. Her account name also remains Vidya Vinu Mohan.The differences in their social media activity had led to questions among fans. However, neither Vinu Mohan nor Vidya has publicly explained the reasons behind their separation. The two are reportedly planning to move forward with their respective careers. Details about their personal decision have not been made public.Vinu Mohan's acting careerVinu Mohan made his debut as a lead actor with the Malayalam film 'Nivedyam' which turned out to be a superhit. He comes from a prominent family associated with Malayalam cinema.Vinu Mohan is the grandson of veteran actor Kottarakkara Sreedharan Nair. He is also the son of actress Shobha Mohan and the brother of actor Anu Mohan. Actor Saikumar is his maternal uncle. His early filmography includes 'Cycle', 'Chattambinadu' and 'Pulimurugan'.Vidya's film and television journeyVidya began her acting career with the 2007 Tamil film 'Dhandayuthapani'. She later made her Malayalam cinema debut with 'Neelambari' in 2009. The actress went on to appear in several Malayalam films. Her credits include 'Cheriya Kallanum Valiya Policum' and 'Maharaja Talkies'.Vidya has acted in around 15 Malayalam films. She has also appeared in six Tamil films and one Kannada film. articles.title: The Paradise’: Nani-Srikanth Odela’s ‘A’ certificate action thriller hit the big screens on September 24; here’s what to expect
articles.summary: Nani is gearing up for the one of the most anticipated films of his career as it is reported his biggest film and also the “most tiring” is his long c.
articles.body: Nani is gearing up for the one of the most anticipated films of his career as it is reported his biggest film and also the “most tiring” is his long career of 18 years. The film is set to release in theatres on September 24 after much delays and special screens locked in the evening a prior. There are many expectations from the film as it portrays Nani in a bigger, darker, and rawer character as Jadal reuniting with his ‘Dasara’ director Srikanth Odela.‘The Paradise’ has had a bumpy road to release, earlier it was set for a March 2026 release which later shifted to August. However, after much speculation that it will be further pushed the makers announced a September release. Additionally, the makers have also skipped a conventional trailer release of the film as they were focused on enhancing the final product and other post-production work.No trailer for‘The Paradise’Although they haven’t released the trailer, the other promotional material including the teasers, posters and songs have already created huge buzz and anticipation for the film. Even though the film has received an ‘A’ certificate for its raw and violence content which is considered to cut the family going audience, the early bookings have shown promising numbers.Nani’s transformation as JadalFurther talking about the film, the makers created multiple big sets to capture the slums of the 1980s from Secunderabad where the story is primarily set. Nani has gone under a never seen before transformation for his look as Jadal with the Srikanth Odela at the director’s seat, expectations are that the viewers will get to see a much sharper and stronger film than ‘Dasara’.Nani’s look includes two thick braids, nose piercings, a bindi, and a beefed-up frame that make him nearly unrecognizable.A story about identity and leadershipThe story of the film is set to show a marginalized tribal community who is stripped of its rights and denied citizenship under a deeply entrenched feudal system. Nani's character Jadal is expected to be seen as a leader who unites his people and leads their fight for recognition. The film's guiding line, per its director: "You don't need an identity to be a leader."Mohan Babu and Raghav Juyal as the antagonistsNani is shown as a strong protagonist and strong leads need strong villains. Standing in his way are the feudal lord Shikanja Malik played by Mohan Babu and his ruthless son Vikram Malik played by ‘Kill’ and ‘Bads of Bollywood’ fame Raghav Juyal, locked in a brutal struggle for control over the land called Paradise.Sonali Kulkarni on the mother-son storyInside this conflict, has an emotional core of a mother-son story. Sonali Kulkarni who plays Nani’s mother as Sammakka in the film will be also playing an important role. While speaking with Mid-day, she talked about playing Sammakka and the reason behind the conflict in the film. “Here in The Paradise, I had to understand where we are living, what this fight is all about and what I am thinking as a woman,” she said.The film also features Kayadu Lohar will be seen playing the female lead playing the character Subbalakshmi affectionately called Subbu.Anirudh Ravichander’s music in ‘The Paradise’Musically, with Anirudh Ravichander as the composer, it has been a cultural moment of its own. The intro anthem ‘Aaya Sher’ received huge acclaim. The second single, ‘Yeshanagula,’ brings back ‘Dasara’ co-star Keerthy Suresh while third song ‘Anjaana Anjaani’ is a romantic number featuring the leads.Special show and ticket price detailsA few days ago, a notice issued by Telangana Home Department permitted a special show on September 23 at 6:30 PM, with tickets priced at Rs 500 including GST. Meanwhile, from September 24 to 27, single-screen theatres can charge an additional Rs 48, including GST, while multiplexes and special theatres can charge an additional Rs 95. If its extended theatrical run continues to generate steady collections, the film could subsequently aim for Rs 290 crore before approaching the more substantial Rs 300 crore India net milestone. Its unusual week-on-week growth means that the final total could remain dependent on how long the film continues to command screens and audience interest. articles.title: How Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ became the longest-running No. 1 hit of all time
articles.summary: Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas,” a simmering, midtempo, country-and-then-some heartbreak song released last October, is indisputably 2026’s biggest hit.
articles.body: NEW YORK — Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas,” a simmering, midtempo, country-and-then-some heartbreak song released last October, is indisputably 2026’s biggest hit. “Choosin’ Texas” is also the longest-running No. 1 hit in the U.S., having spent 23 weeks at the top spot on the all-genre Billboard Hot 100, it was announced Tuesday. That means the track has surpassed various records set by Shaboozey’s “A Bar Song (Tipsy),” Lil Nas X’s “Old Town Road,” Whitney Houston’s “I Will Always Love You” and most impressively, Mariah Carey’s “All I Want For Christmas Is You.” Her holiday classic held the previous record, with 22 weeks at No. 1. The song’s laid-back sound, cross-genre appeal and heartache narrative are a few reasons why. But its dominance still comes as a surprise. Here’s how ‘Choosin’ Texas’ became so popular Luminate, the industry data and analytics company, found that “Choosin’ Texas” brought in 911 million on-demand streams in the U.S. and 1.26 billion globally as of mid-August. Considering that Langley started 2023, around the time she made her Grand Ole Opry debut, with under 1 million monthly listeners on Spotify — and now boasts of over 32 million — her rise has been meteoric. Historically, country listenership has centered on radio play. That has changed somewhat as the genre grows in popularity, solidifying around what Luminate’s Jaime Marconette describes as a “younger, streaming-forward listener.” He says it is a “multiyear narrative accelerated” by hits like “Choosin’ Texas.” Claire Heinichen, a senior editor at Spotify, says the song’s growth has been both explosive and consistent. “Choosin’ Texas” “started big,” she says, moving from the platform’s leading country playlist, ‘Hot Country,’ to its larger, generic offerings because it works across audiences. “It made its way into ‘Today’s Top Hits,’ which is our biggest global flagship playlist, but it’s also showing up in ‘Mood’ and ‘Moments’ playlists because it fits so well in ‘driving’ or ‘chill’ or ‘cookout,’” Heinichen says. “It really can work everywhere.” It’s not just country music fans who are connecting with “Choosin’ Texas.” “The song’s success on a playlist like ‘Today’s Top Hits’ is an indication that this is working for audiences who are not seeking out one specific genre,” Heinichen says. “It’s definitely growing in every direction.” The specific sound of ‘Choosin’ Texas’ speaks to its staying power Go straight to Langley’s voice for another explanation for the song’s success. It’s “like syrup,” says Nate Sloan, a musicologist, assistant professor at the University of Southern California and co-host of the podcast “Switched On Pop.” She sings in long phrases that lull the listener into the song’s rhythm, from its opening guitar line to its coda. “It’s almost like a trance,” Sloan says. It also pulls from other genres; a cross-pollination found in much modern country. Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” features shimmery disco grooves, not unlike Kacey Musgraves. “It’s a little more rock or even kind of soul-inflected,” Sloan says. “Part of the reason songs like ‘Choosin’ Texas’ are able to resonate with such a wide audience is because, musically, they’re bringing in a lot of diverse influences.” Charles L. Hughes, a Rhodes College professor and author of “Country Soul,” says the song sounds like many different eras of country music and, simultaneously, contemporary. To his ears, “Choosin’ Texas” pulls from a late 1970s, early ’80s era of country musicians who pulled R&B and pop into their sound — think Ronnie Milsap, Barbara Mandrell and Charlie Rich — but it isn’t stuck in that period. Those sounds are filtered through a post-Musgraves, post-Miranda Lambert songwriting style, with Langley’s idiosyncratic charms. (Lambert and Langley are two of the song’s four cowriters.) “The best country music has one foot in the past and one foot into the present, if not the future,” Hughes says. “And that’s what she’s doing.” Even for its light, bright musicality, “Choosin’ Texas” is an unusual hit, because it doesn’t possess the features that historically make up a No. 1 smash. It’s super specific — with its detailed descriptions of characters and geography in the lyrics — which is “antithetical to what you usually expect from a big, hit pop song that’s supposed to appeal to everyone,” says Sloan. It’s also “chill,” Sloan says. “It’s not bombastic or anthemic.” “It has no big moments,” says Hughes. But it has both a subtle dance pulse and steel guitar, so “it sounds country, but it doesn’t automatically turn off people who are allergic to certain kinds of country sounds.” There’s a sparkle that transgresses genre lines, but it does so while sounding mellow — the kind of track that inspires repeat listens. The lyrics of ‘Choosin’ Texas’ have a few things going for them “Choosin’ Texas” continues a great tradition of “songs that country women do about what men do in bars,” says Hughes. It’s straightforward: She’s losing her lover to someone else. She’s not going to fight for him — it’s a song of resignation that ends with her drinking alone as he chooses Texas (another woman) over her (and Tennessee). It’s a universal heartbreak theme with potential for cross-generational resonance: It works for both the insecurity of a first breakup and a long-term relationship ending over another woman, or a move. “It’s got these great turns of phrase that give you a little bit of ironic distance as a narrator and as a listener,” says Sloan. “It doesn’t take a crystal ball to see,” Langley acquiesces in the chorus, “A cowboy always finds a way to leave.” The lyrics are also clever, standing out in contemporary country, says Hughes. (Compare it to Luke Bryan’s “Fish Hunt Golf Drink.”) And it’s detailed: Langley’s paramour loves George Strait’s “Amarillo by Morning,” a pantheon Texas track; she’s drinking Tennessee whiskey as a result. “There is the phenomenon of what some critics have called ‘the sad banger’ within the world of pop music,” says Sloan. In country, it’s even more common to take something sad and transform it into something funny or deadpan. “And that’s what she’s really good at, at this song.” ‘Choosin’ Texas’ says a lot about music in 2026 The fact that regular chart-toppers like Taylor Swift, Morgan Wallen and Bad Bunny haven’t released new albums this year could’ve cleared a path for the dominance of “Choosin’ Texas,” but Sloan sees its rise as indicative of something else. “We’re in this environment where you can measure a song’s success in a numerical way,” he says. “But then in terms of its actual cultural impact, that might be more fragmented than you think.” Essentially: “Choosin’ Texas” is on top. But how many people know Langley’s name, the way they knew Houston’s and Carey’s when those hits were released? “It doesn’t feel like a centerpiece of a monoculture, but it is absolutely a key part of like radio culture, streaming playlists, TikTok,” Hughes adds. “But it’s hitting these various audiences in a way that combines to create something huge.” But what does it forecast for Langley? She’s no one-hit wonder: Her award-winning 2024 collaboration with Riley Green, “You Look Like You Love Me” is evidence of that. “It’s always hard to prognosticate with artists when they have an unexpected smash,” says Sloan. “Her ability to write songs with a lot of integrity that both reach back into country tradition and incorporate sounds of the 21st century? That’s a pretty good formula to have a successful and long career in the music world.”

articles.title: Ferran Adrià, chef, da las claves para hacer una tortilla de patatas: "Es una de las grandes cumbres de la gastronomía mundial"
articles.standfirst: El copropietario de 'elBulli', uno de los mejores 50 restaurantes del Mundo, siempre ha sido claro con este tradicional plato
articles.summary: El copropietario de 'elBulli', uno de los mejores 50 restaurantes del Mundo, siempre ha sido claro con este tradicional plato
articles.body: Pocos platos representan la identidad de la cocina española con la fuerza de la tortilla de patatas, y pocos cocineros han reflexionado tanto sobre su técnica como Ferran Adrià. A lo largo de sus distintas intervenciones públicas y publicaciones, el chef catalán ha defendido de manera insistente que la alta cocina no empieza en la centrifugadora ni en los tubos de ensayo, sino en la comprensión profunda de las elaboraciones tradicionales más sencillas. Durante la presentación de su proyecto de cocina cotidiana 'El menú de la familia', Ferran Adrià dejó clara la jerarquía fundamental que debe regir en cualquier cocina: "Primero hay que dominar lo básico: saber hacer un sofrito, limpiar un pescado o hacer una buena tortilla de patatas tradicional. Si no sabes hacer eso con maestría, no puedes pretender hacer cocina creativa ni de vanguardia". Con estas palabras, el cocinero recordaba que el dominio técnico de las bases es la condición indispensable para cualquier innovación posterior. Lejos de la imagen preconcebida que situaba a 'elBulli' como un espacio ajeno a la cocina popular, Ferran Adrià situó a la tortilla clásica en la cima de la gastronomía. En diversos foros del proyecto 'Sapiens' de la 'elBulliFoundation', el chef ha afirma que "para mí, una tortilla de patatas clásica bien hecha —jugosa por dentro, con la patata bien confitada y el huevo apenas cuajado— es una de las grandes cumbres de la gastronomía mundial". Para el cocinero, la clave del éxito reside en la precisión de los tiempos y en el equilibrio térmico al confitar la patata. Esta devoción por la receta clásica no le impidió romper moldes a finales de los años noventa con su famosa "tortilla desconstruida" servida en copa. Como explicó en el documental 'elBulli': Historia de un sueño de TVE, el objetivo de aquella elaboración no era sustituir al plato de toda la vida: "Cuando hicimos en 'elBulli' la tortilla de patatas en copa, usando patatas fritas de bolsa, huevos y cebolla, la gente se llevaba las manos a la cabeza. Pero el concepto no era sustituir a la de la abuela, sino hacer una reflexión: ¿cuáles son los ingredientes de una tortilla? Patata, huevo, aceite y cebolla. Si utilizas una patata frita de bolsa de máxima calidad, rehidratada con el huevo, consigues la esencia del sabor y una textura diferente en tres minutos". Finalmente, respecto a una de las polémicas más célebres de la gastronomía española, Adrià ha ofrecido un análisis puramente técnico. En entrevistas concedidas a medios como El País Semanal con motivo de debates en certámenes como Madrid Fusión, el cocinero valoró el papel de la cebolla señalando que "el debate de si la tortilla debe llevar cebolla o no es una cuestión de gusto personal, pero desde el punto de vista culinario, la cebolla aporta un dulzor y una humedad que ayudan a que el resultado final sea mucho más jugoso". De este modo, el chef demuestra que cada ingrediente debe responder a una función sensorial precisa en el plato.

articles.body: Vivek Oberoi has spoken in support of Salman Khan’s recent comments on online trolling. Salman had called out social media users for body-shaming and age-shaming celebrities, questioning why people resort to abusing actors simply because they do not approve of their work. His comments received support from several celebrities, including Varun Dhawan, Neha Dhupia and filmmaker Rohit Shetty. Vivek has now also agreed with Salman’s stance, saying there is no reason to engage in negativity.Vivek was recently spotted spending time with children battling cancer at an event organised by the Cancer Patients Aid Association (CPAA). During a conversation with Bollywood Chronicle, he was asked about Salman speaking against trolls on 'Bigg Boss 20'. Vivek said, "Kuch nahi yaar, mujhe lagta hai trolling wagera karna bhi nahi chahiye. Trolling is a very negative thing, and there are a lot of positive things to do in life kya negative mein padhe ho (Nothing, yaar. I feel people shouldn’t troll others either. Trolling is a very negative thing, and there are so many positive things to do in life. Why get caught up in negativity?)."Salman had addressed the issue of online trolling during the latest Weekend Ka Vaar episode of 'Bigg Boss 20'. Talking about the scrutiny faced by celebrities over their appearance, the actor revealed that he has also been targeted online and has been called "budha", while social media users have also mocked his new bald look.The superstar also came to Katrina Kaif's defence after she faced criticism over her post-pregnancy appearance. Referring to the trolling directed at the actress, Salman said, "Everyone puts on weight after getting pregnant. When she returns to films, she will get back in shape. She wants to spend time with her family."Salman also addressed the comments aimed at his own physique. In response to those who had body-shamed him, he removed his T-shirt and showed off his toned physique. articles.title: Reunion with Srikanth Odela, Nani’s new avatar, Anirudh’s music: 5 reasons to watch ‘The Paradise’
articles.summary: Natural Star Nani is returning to the big screens with the upcoming action thriller ‘The Paradise’ directed by Srikanth Odela. The film has been in pr.
articles.body: Natural Star Nani is returning to the big screens with the upcoming action thriller ‘The Paradise’ directed by Srikanth Odela. The film has been in production since June 2025 and after a couple of delays is finally hitting the big screens on September 24 with some special early shows scheduled in the evening on September 23. Let’s take a look at some of the reasons to watch the film.Reunion of Nani and Srikanth Odela after ‘Dasara’‘The Paradise’ marks the second project between Nani and Srikanth Odela after their 2023 hit ‘Dasara’. The film received huge critical acclaim which captured the rustic authenticity of a coal mine. Given this was Odela's first film, he received appreciation for its polished and confident staging. Now, with ‘The Paradise’ expectations are high for the pair repeating that magic. Recently, Nani shared that he could see Srikanth Odela’s evolution as a filmmaker while speaking with Variety India. He shared that for ‘The Paradise’ Srikanth was in full control of the set unlike ‘Dasara’.“As far as ‘Dasara’ goes, Srikanth comes from this small town called Godavarikhani in Telangana and his dad worked in a coal mine there. He understood that world well and was able to make a film like ‘Dasara.’ But when it came to “The Paradise,” a lot of research was required. When Srikanth was directing ‘Dasara,’ he never imagined he’d do something like ‘The Paradise.’ But the way he has researched and evolved to make a film like this is admirable,” Nani said.Nani’s new avatar in ‘The Paradise’In the film, Nani will be seen playing the character Jadal who seems to be playing a leader of the marginalized community who are fighting for justice and against the oppression. For the film he will be seen donning a brand new look making one of the most talked-about elements of the film. Nani has long hair where he keeps two thick braids while he also wears nose piercings and a bindi, giving him a tribal, rugged aesthetic.Nani has also muscled up his physique as his looks from the films shows a noticeable build. Interestingly, Nani in his 18 years career, called ‘The Paradise’ his most physically demanding look yet. While interacting with the media during the event, the ‘HIT: The Third Case’ actor said, “The Paradise is the most tiring film of my career, both physically and mentally. If there has been a film for which I have worked very hard in these 18 years of my film career, it is 'The Paradise'.”Story of rebellion‘The Paradise’ is primarily set around the 1980's of Secunderabad and in and around a slum settlement. From the promos released one can establish that it is about a marginalized tribal community who is long denied basic rights, citizenship and face systemic oppression. Nani is described to be someone with no conventional standing, who rises from within this community to unite them and fight back.Earlier, Nani himself described the film as "India's Mad Max". It is set to show him in an unhinged avatar, some ruthlessly killings as the film has received an ‘A’ rated certificate from the censor board.Cast of ‘The Paradise’The Srikanth Odela directorial has a star studded cast as it features Nani as Jadal and also includes ‘Dragon’ fame Kayadu Lohar as the female lead. Nani will be seen clashing with the feudal lords who are holding power over the land called "Paradise". It features Tollywood veteran Mohan Babu as Shikanja Malik and Bollywood actor Raghav Juyal as his son Vikram Malik, a ruthless enforcer.The film also has Sonali Kulkarni and Sampoornesh Babu in supporting roles.Anirudh Ravichander’s soundtrackStar musician Anirudh Ravichander is composing songs for ‘The Paradise’. His first single ‘Aaya Sher’ was released as a birthday special for Nani. The song includes tribal percussion and gritty electronic layers, a touch of Anirudh. Folk singers Addula Jangireddy and Akunoori Deviah lend fierce, earthy vocals alongside Anirudh which received huge appreciation from the listeners.Another song, ‘Yeshanagula’ is a special one in the film as it brings back Keerthy Suresh who worked with Nani and Srikanth in Dasara for a special cameo.Recently the makers also dropped the third single, ‘Anjaana Anjaani’ which is a romance number features Nani and Kayadu Lohar.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Presley Gerber’s final hours at rehab in focus amid cause of death questions
articles.summary: Presley Gerber's final hours draws questions. Police are investigating the 27-year-old model's death as a suspected overdose.
articles.body: Presley Gerber died Sunday, Sept. 20 – one day after entering the Resolutions Living rehabilitation facility in Santa Monica, Calif. He was 27. Based off Wilshire Boulevard in an affluent Southern California community, the center is described as a co-ed home which "provides the structure" for residents on their journey to recovery from mental health, addiction, and co-occurring disorders through intensive outpatient programs of their choosing. While it remained unclear why Cindy Crawford's son entered the center or what treatment he was receiving, wrongful death and personal injury attorney John J. Perlstein warned against jumping to conclusions of liability as the investigation continued into Gerber's death. PRESLEY GERBER'S DEATH BEING INVESTIGATED AS 'A SUSPECTED OVERDOSE': POLICE "I just don't assume what the cause of death is or that the facility failed them or the family ... don't think the family wasn't doing everything they had to do," Perlstein told Fox News Digital. "It seems like, you know, in these situations the families do so much for the sick person, the person who was addicted." He added, "By all accounts, they were a very loving, good family, and it's just real sad circumstance. It certainly caught a lot of people's attention. I'll tell you that much." Gerber, the only son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and businessman Rande Gerber, died while staying at the rehabilitation facility, according to records from the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner. KID ROCK CALLS PRESLEY GERBER’S DEATH A ‘TRAGEDY’ AS EX-GIRLFRIEND SAYS HE ‘DESERVED MORE TIME’ The treatment center's website says it draws "on our years of experience in addiction and mental health support," with "experienced staff has supported people with a wide variety of needs, from substance abuse and mental health, to trauma and eating disorders." Gerber reportedly checked into the facility on Saturday night and died Sunday morning. Representatives for Resolutions Living did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment. Nicholas Kardaris, Ph.D., CEO and chief clinical officer of the New York Center for Living in Manhattan and a clinical professor at Stony Brook Medicine’s School of Social Welfare, cautioned against drawing conclusions from the fact that he died at a rehabilitation facility. CINDY CRAWFORD’S SON PRESLEY GERBER SAID HE WAS ‘TERRIFIED’ IN RAW ADDICTION POST MONTHS BEFORE DEATH AT 27 As Gerber’s official cause of death has not yet been released, Kardaris — who has not treated Presley Gerber and is not connected to the case — noted that possible explanations could include an acute medical or cardiac event, an undiagnosed condition or a medication-related complication. People in residential treatment facilities may have complex medical histories, and some conditions may not be immediately apparent when someone enters a program. "Younger people can sometimes die suddenly, and we don’t know whether they had an underlying medical issue," Kardaris said. "It’s not impossible to have a medication-related event, particularly if someone has an underlying heart disorder," he continued. "Certain medications can trigger a cardiac episode." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS He added, "People are in rehab because they’re struggling with addiction. It doesn’t mean they’re cured of their addiction." Another potential risk during rehab is withdrawal itself, which can range from uncomfortable to life-threatening depending on the substance involved and the person’s level of physical dependence, according to Kardaris. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "People can die from withdrawal, but the substances that are most dangerous to withdraw [from] without proper medical supervision are benzodiazepines, such as Valium or Xanax, and alcohol," he said. The deputy medical examiner (DME) told Fox News Digital that "the investigation is still ongoing and there is limited information available," and his cause of death has not yet been released. The DME is in "the early stages of investigating the death of 27-year-old model Presley Gerber and limited information is currently available," according to a statement from the department. They added, "Due to the ongoing death investigation, the DME cannot disclose what testing and/or studies were requested. Deferred cases can take a few months before a cause of death is determined." Santa Monica Police Department officials are investigating the death as "a suspected overdose," according to a release from the department. Officers responded to a report of a possible overdose at approximately 9:35 a.m., Sunday, Sept. 20. Upon arrival, officers located an adult male who was deceased. At this time, there is no indication of foul play, and Gerber's case remains open. The facility has not been accused of wrongdoing. articles.summary: Samay Raina’s 'India’s Got Latent 2' has come under fresh scrutiny after a complaint was filed against casting director Mukesh Chhabra and Netflix Ind.
articles.body: Samay Raina’s 'India’s Got Latent 2' has come under fresh scrutiny after a complaint was filed against casting director Mukesh Chhabra and Netflix India over allegedly inappropriate language used during a recent episode of the comedy show.The complaint was filed by Anurag Shrivastav, who has raised concerns over remarks he allegedly heard while watching the episode featuring actor Nawazuddin Siddiqui, actor and YouTuber Bhuvan Bam, Mukesh Chhabra, stand-up comedian Kaustubh Agarwal and host Samay Raina. The episode premiered on September 18 on Netflix and YouTube.What the complaint against Mukesh Chhabra allegesAccording to the IANS report, Shrivastav said he was watching Netflix on his laptop from a Mumbai hotel room on the evening of September 22, 2026, when he came across the 'India’s Got Latent' episode.The complaint alleges that Chhabra was heard making the remark, “Mere Aaram Nagar mein aao, gaand marao.”The complainant described the alleged language as “highly inappropriate, objectionable, and sexually suggestive” and sought verification of the statement before any conclusions are drawn.The complaint itself reportedly acknowledges that “the authenticity of this statement, the identification of the voice/person, the complete context, and the exact timestamp need to be verified from the original and unedited recording.”Complainant questions Netflix India’s roleShrivastav has also questioned Netflix’s role in approving and streaming the content. According to the complaint, if the alleged remark is authenticated, it could raise concerns around viewer dignity and child cyber safety.The complaint has sought an inquiry into how the content was approved for streaming and has also called for an examination of the role of Monika Shergill, Netflix India’s content chief. These remain allegations and requests made in the complaint; there is no indication in the cited report that the claims have been established.'India’s Got Latent 2' has faced fresh controversyThe complaint comes days after the latest episode of 'India’s Got Latent 2' generated discussion online over jokes involving Mukesh Chhabra. The episode also saw Samay Raina make remarks about Chhabra’s girlfriend, while an unverified social media claim alleged that the shoot was briefly halted. Raina later responded to that claim on Instagram with a humorous post, without confirming the reported incident.The episode featured Chhabra alongside Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Bhuvan Bam and Kaustubh Agarwal. Raina also roasted Nawazuddin over his appearance in Thamma during the episode.The show was previously at the centre of a major controversyThis is not the first major controversy associated with 'India’s Got Latent'. In February 2025, comedian and podcaster Ranveer Allahbadia faced widespread criticism over remarks concerning parents and sex during an episode of the show's first season. The controversy subsequently led to legal proceedings and significant public scrutiny of the programme.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Netflix turns Willy Wonka’s chocolate factory into a real-life ‘social experiment’
articles.summary: Lickable wallpaper.
articles.body: Lickable wallpaper. An edible garden replete with gummy foliage. A chocolate river made of 25,000 gallons of chocolate goop. Nods to the “Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory” films appear everywhere in Netflix’s new reality competition show “Wonka’s The Golden Ticket.” But the show, which debuted on the streamer Wednesday, also embraces the darker elements of Roald Dahl’s 1964 children’s book and subsequent films. Unlike the original story, which ultimately rewards protagonist Charlie for his humility and lack of greed after a tour of Wonka’s whimsical chocolate factory, Netflix’s series incentivizes contestants to scheme and strategize to win a $3 million prize. “This is the modern-day take on the movie, so we weren’t really ever trying to be the morality police. We never ever wanted to set out to be the producers that dictated who behaved well and who behaved poorly,” said showrunner Emer Harkin. “Because let’s be real, we’re all human. We all make mistakes. We all misbehave. We seek redemption. We all have our inflected storylines, and so that was important for us.” Yet when the trailer dropped earlier this year, fans of the pop culture classic appeared less preoccupied with the reality twist on the story than with another creative choice: the use of generative AI to replicate the late Gene Wilder’s voice from the original 1971 film. “A whole new generation of real-life Golden Ticket holders will compete for a life-changing prize or say a most unfortunate goodbye,” the AI-generated voice of Wilder says in the series. “Marvel at the magic you remember and delight in my newest wonders beyond imagination. The most extraordinary competition on Earth is about to begin.” The decision is one that Harkin and co-showrunner Alison Holloway stand behind, saying the use of Wilder’s likeness meant to honor him, not diminish his legacy. It was done with explicit approval, and encouragement, from his estate and wife. “The more we developed the series, the more we kept thinking: What would Wonka do at this point? What would Wonka say? i.e., What would Gene Wilder say?” Holloway said. “So it became clear to us that Gene Wilder was perhaps the only voice that could do this.” No in-person hosts appear in the show, but the disembodied AI-generated replica of Wilder’s voice floats in every so often to announce new challenges and contestant terminations. The emerging use of generative AI in Hollywood has stirred pushback from film industry workers, who say they’re worried about loss of labor in an already dismal market for entertainment jobs. When the “Wonka” reality show trailer was released, some fans online suggested that Wilder wouldn’t have signed off on the project if he were alive today, pointing to how he criticized the 2005 “Wonka” remake. Holloway said she understands and shares people’s concerns over AI use. But receiving support from Wilder’s widow, Karen Boyer, made her feel at peace with the decision to proceed with the idea. “I think we have to believe that the people who loved him the most want this to happen,” Holloway said. “And of course, it’s out of total respect for his legacy that we’ve gone to such lengths to get it as best as we can.” In order for the show to capture the cadence, the tone and the “whimsy” of Wilder’s voice, the team behind the show sifted through hours of Wilder’s audiobooks, which Boyer provided to them. Netflix partnered with the AI voice generation company ElevenLabs, which has been making inroads in Hollywood in recent years collaborating with both studios and celebrities. To bring the fictional world to life, Netflix employed a team of working magicians to make the “magic” feel real to the contestants. The competitors, who earned their entry onto the show by finding a golden ticket hidden within a Wonka-themed chocolate bar, arrive at the giant chocolate factory to face off in a phantasmagoria of dramatic candy-colored challenges. In the first challenge of the show, some contestants disappeared in a puff of fog while sitting right beside their partners — extracting reactions that the showrunners said “had to be absolutely authentic.” “We watched that movie over and over and over again, and it gave us the template for the 2026 social experiment,” Holloway said. “We hope we’ve captured all the nostalgia … the magic that was always there, the unpredictability that was always there, the sort of darkness that was always there.”

articles.title: 'Lioness' star weighs in on what drove Taylor Sheridan's unexpected decision for her character
articles.summary: Elizaveta Neretin reacts to Taylor Sheridan's outcome for her "Lioness" character Oleksandra Balakin in the season 3 finale.
articles.body: WARNING: Spoilers below. "Lioness" star Elizaveta Neretin reacted to Taylor Sheridan's bombshell season 3 finale, which saw her character, Oleksandra Balakin, killed off. Speaking to Fox News Digital, Neretin — who played the Ukrainian double agent — said she expected Oleksandra's fate. The character had been captured by American forces and recruited to help rescue Joe (Zoe Saldaña) after she was kidnapped. In the episode, which aired Sunday night, Oleksandra was killed. 'LIONESS' SEASON 3 FINALE REVEALS WHO ORCHESTRATED JOE'S KIDNAPPING ALL ALONG "I thought it was going to happen. So when he called, and he told me, I was like, 'Yeah, I get it.' I'm sad for Oleksandra and what Oleksandra represents, but I understand the choice. It does serve this. It serves to show how the whole system is. Like American or not American, the whole system and the people that work in the system. It's all sharks, you know, so it just demonstrates how people are," she told Fox News Digital. Neretin said she would have preferred a different outcome for Oleksandra but understood why Sheridan made the decision. "I would love a different ending for her, but like I said, I understand why it had to happen." "I would love a different ending for her, but like I said, I understand why it had to happen. But, of course, I would have a good ending for her. I just wonder if being a triple agent, I think your days are numbered. I don't think you can pull that off and live to an old age unless you give up on family you have, which I don't think she would." But the way she fights for her country, I think she cares way too much, way more about that outcome than her life. I think that she made that decision a long time ago," Neretin said. The actress said she never asked Sheridan whether he had considered an alternative ending for Oleksandra. Instead, she trusted his creative judgment and did not try to challenge him while working on the series. "No, I didn't challenge him. I just remember he shortened Oleksandra's name a certain way, and I just suggested, I was like, 'By the way, the short version of Oleksandra in Ukrainian is Alessa.' And he was like, 'Yeah, that works,'" she began. "I didn't challenge him, it was very interesting, like he runs the show, you know what I mean? He's the boss." Nicole Kidman, who plays Kaitlyn in "Lioness," was also asked whether her character felt remorse over Oleksandra's death during an interview with Entertainment Weekly. articles.title: Biswajit Chatterjee recalls giving 'Rocky' title to Sanjay Dutt's debut project, bonds with Sunil Dutt family
articles.summary: Veteran actor Biswajit Chatterjee, who has worked with some of Hindi cinema's biggest stars including Dilip Kumar, Pran, Raaj Kumar, recalled a special
articles.body: Veteran actor Biswajit Chatterjee, who has worked with some of Hindi cinema's biggest stars including Dilip Kumar, Pran, Raaj Kumar, recalled a special chapter from his decades-long journey in the film industry about giving the title 'Rocky' to Sunil Dutt for his son Sanjay Dutt's debut film.In a conversation with ANI, Biswajit revealed that he originally owned the title 'Rocky' for a film he planned to make as a producer-director with Amitabh Bachchan and Rekha. However, the project was eventually shelved, following which Sunil Dutt approached him while launching Sanjay Dutt in Bollywood and requested the title for his son's debut film.The veteran actor recalled that his close relationship with the Dutt family led him to hand over the title without any hesitation."Sunil Dutt said, 'Apne bete ke liye film bana raha hu..yeh title Sanju baba ko bahut suit karega' (I am making a film for my son, Biswajit. This title suits Sanju Babu a lot}. Our relationship with him, Sunil Dutt, Nargis Bhabhi, you know, like a family relationship. I said, take it now," he recalled.Biswajit said that he refused to accept any payment for the title and gave it to Sunil Dutt because of their personal bond."He said, how much money will you take for it? I said, what are you saying...? Next day, I gave it to him. Rocky. I gave the title of the first film..," he said.The actor also remembered the emotional moment linked to the film's release, saying Sanjay Dutt's mother Nargis Dutt could not witness the release of Rocky as she passed away due to cancer.'Rocky' is a 1981 romantic action film directed by Sunil Dutt. This film marks the debut of Sanjay Dutt and also stars Tina Munim, Reena Roy, Amjad Khan, Raakhee, Ranjeet, Shakti Kapoor and Aruna Irin pivotal roles.Biswajit, who became one of the popular romantic heroes of the 1960s with films like 'Bees Saal Baad', 'Kohraa', 'Mere Sanam' and 'Kismat', continues to remain connected with cinema and still enjoys watching films in theatres.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Nani’s 'The Paradise' advance booking crosses Rs 40 crore before release as Srikanth Odela directorial records strong demand despite ‘A’ certificate
articles.summary: Nani’s 'The Paradise' is heading towards its theatrical release with strong momentum at the ticket counters.
articles.body: Nani’s 'The Paradise' is heading towards its theatrical release with strong momentum at the ticket counters. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the action drama is set to arrive in cinemas on September 24, with paid premiere shows beginning on Wednesday evening. Despite receiving an ‘A’ certificate from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), the film has recorded a strong pre-release response across key markets, with advance bookings crossing the Rs 40 crore mark.'The Paradise' advance booking crosses Rs 40 croreAccording to trade estimates reported by Sacnilk, The Paradise has generated Rs 40.86 crore in advance bookings across six show dates, including block seats. Excluding block seats, the advance collection stands at Rs 33.82 crore.The film’s opening day, Thursday, September 24, is currently driving the advance sales, contributing Rs 19.92 crore. Hyderabad has emerged as the biggest contributor, with the city accounting for Rs 7.47 crore in advance bookings. With bookings continuing ahead of release, the figures could rise further before the first-day shows begin.Nani’s 'The Paradise' records strong opening-day demandThe advance-booking trend points to substantial demand for 'The Paradise', particularly in the Telugu-speaking markets. Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are contributing significantly to the film’s early sales, while the North American market has also registered notable pre-release demand.With paid premieres scheduled ahead of the September 24 release, the film will get an early opportunity to translate its strong ticket sales into theatrical footfall. The final opening-day numbers will depend on additional bookings and occupancy across the remaining shows.'The Paradise' eyes a career-best opening for NaniThe strong advance sales have raised expectations around 'The Paradise', which marks Nani’s second collaboration with Srikanth Odela after Dasara. Nani plays Jadal, a character from a marginalised community in 1980s Secunderabad, in a story centred on oppression, survival and the fight for basic rights.The film also stars Raghav Juyal, Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar in key roles.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Travis Kelce reacts to Taylor Swift’s viral touchdown moment at Chiefs game: ‘Just doing my deed as a husband’
articles.summary: Kelce scored his first touchdown of the NFL season against the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.
articles.body:
Travis Kelce reacts to Taylor Swift's joyous response to his touchdown on Sunday.

The NFL star said he's "just doing my deed as a husband."

Swift went viral after she celebrated his goal by pointing to her ring and saying, "That's my husband!"

Travis Kelce is simply just being a good husband when he plays good football.

The Kansas City Chiefs star reacted to his wife Taylor Swift 's exuberant response to him scoring his first touchdown of the 2026-2027 NFL season, admitting he's got to deliver the goals for his girl.

"Just doing my deed as a husband," Travis said on his and brother Jason Kelce's New Heights podcast Wednesday, Sept. 23, as they looked through memes of her celebratory moment.

"Internet's having a good ol' time with this s---," Travis said while he and Jason read through the viral posts. "Listen man, proud wife, baby. Gotta make my girl proud."

Swift was beyond proud of her hubby as he caught a 13-yard pass from quarterback Patrick Mahomes in the first quarter of the Chiefs' game against the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday, Sept. 20. She was seen jumping out of her seat and excitedly pointing to her wedding ring as Travis ran the ball into the end zone.

The "Patient Zero" singer appeared to say, "That's my husband," according to clips on social media .

The Chiefs went on to win the game 33-30, and Travis surpassed Hall of Fame running back Marshall Faulk after reaching over 6,288 career yards after the catch (YAC), taking the top YAC spot in NFL history .

Travis spoke about his record-breaking play on New Heights , telling his brother, "You got to find the void and, on top of that, be on time with the QB." He said Mahomes "put [the ball] f---ing right on the money."

"There was never a doubt in our mind that we were going to go out there and do our job," Travis said of his team's win, adding, "there's always something to do better."

This is Travis' first NFL season as a married man after he and Swift tied the knot at New York City's Madison Square Garden in front of 1,000 guests on July 3. Swift has been supporting her now-husband for years at his Chiefs' games, although this go-around seems to be even more momentous.

KC coach Andy Reid said he thinks Swift is one of the reasons why Travis is performing so well on the field during his 14th year on the team.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

"Listen, Trav worked his tail off," Reid told KSHB 41 on Monday, Sept. 21 "Everybody questioned, with the wedding and all that, would he be out of shape... but he works his rear end off. And I think Taylor, you're putting on four-hour shows; you've gotta work hard, too. So I'm sure she kicks him in the butt a little bit there, too."

Swift has been spotted cheering on Travis this month alongside their parents, as well as brother Jason ( and even Tom Cruise ). No doubt there are more newlywed moments to come.

articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' director didn't take fees  before release, will now get Rs 50 crore as the film inspired by Neem Karoli Baba's life crosses Rs 360 crore
articles.summary: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ has turned out to be one of the biggest surprise successes of 2026.
articles.body: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ has turned out to be one of the biggest surprise successes of 2026. The film, which has now completed seven weeks in theatres, continues to draw audiences and is expected to remain on the big screen for a few more weeks. The film has also emerged as the third biggest hit of the year after ‘Dhurandhar 2’ and ‘Border 2’.The film’s modest budget has been one of the biggest talking points surrounding its success. Producer Anupriya Nagar recently revealed that ‘Hanuman Ansh’ was made for a little over Rs 1.5 crore, with Rs 50 lakh coming from her own pocket. She also revealed that director Vishal Chaturvedi did not charge a fee while making the film. Instead, the profits will be shared equally among the three producers and the director.Anupriya revealed in an interview with Siddharth Kannan, “I put in one-third of the entire budget. I put Rs 50 lakh in the film, and the budget was a little over Rs 1.5 crore.”According to trade tracker Sacnilk, the film has earned Rs 366.45 crore gross in its first 47 days. Asked how much of the profits she would take home, Anupriya explained, “I will get one-fourth of the profits. First, the distributor will take their cut. Then we also pay for other expenses and pay taxes. Then whatever is left will be divided among the four of us.”With the film's theatrical performance far exceeding expectations, Anupriya estimates that her individual returns could touch Rs 50 crore. However, she pointed out that the makers are yet to monetise the film through its OTT, satellite and music rights.“So far, it seems like I will be making Rs 50 crore. But all of this is theoretical. We are yet to make an OTT, music and satellite deal,” she said.For Anupriya, the unexpected windfall also comes with a sense of responsibility. Asked what she plans to do with the money, she said, “I don’t even know how to handle this kind of money so I think the best way to go about it is to give back to society.”She also revealed plans to launch her own production house and back more stories, particularly regional films and web series. However, she intends to stick to the low-budget model that worked for ‘Hanuman Ansh’.“I want to make films on small budgets because I know that Hanuman Ansh became possible only because of its small budget. If my budget was too big, I don’t think it would have turned out this way. I want to make sure that I save a certain percentage of money for my production house,” she said.Anupriya also spoke about Vishal Chaturvedi’s long journey with the project. According to her, the filmmaker had been trying to bring the story to audiences for nearly 14 years and had previously approached several OTT platforms.“He had narrated this to many OTT platforms. Ragini Sona and Namrata Singh (co-producers) were the ones who showed faith in the film and said let’s make it,” she said.Anupriya joined the project during post-production, when the team needed additional funds. She said the entire team had faith in Vishal despite ‘Hanuman Ansh’ being his directorial debut.“All of us had faith in Vishal. He is a first-time director and I am glad he got that break. What beautiful direction and script he has written,” she said.She further revealed that Vishal chose not to take a fee during the making of the film because of its limited budget. However, since he is also an equal partner in the company, he will share the profits along with the producers.“Our budget was very minimal, so he said that he won’t take any fee during the making. But in the company, we are all equal partners, so if we are doing well, then the four of us will be doing well,” she said.‘Hanuman Ansh’ is yet to finalise an OTT deal, while its satellite and music deals are also still pending.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Judge Judy says those who don't like America should 'go somewhere else'
articles.summary: Judge Judy doubles down on her love of America, praising capitalism and personal responsibility. The TV icon also addresses 1950s nostalgia and a longing for law and order.
articles.body: Judge Judy is doubling down on her love of America, telling people who want to fundamentally change the country to "go somewhere else." During an interview with USA Today, Judy Sheindlin, 83, opened up about her views on America and the enduring popularity of her courtroom television persona. "I have a house, and I have a home. I consider America my home. America has been good to me. I think that it’s the greatest country in the world," Sheindlin said. JUDGE JUDY PREPARING TO END DECADES-LONG RUN AS TV'S TOUGHEST JUDGE "If you don’t like this country, go somewhere else," she continued. "Don’t come to the greatest country in the world, the most successful country in the world, and say, ‘I want to change it.’ There are other countries that are the something else that you want. Go there. Go there. But don’t come into my home and say, ‘I want to change it.’" "We are a capitalist country that revered excellence, that revered entrepreneurship, that revered all the things that made us great," she added. "Whether you like it or not, it's there." Sheindlin’s comments came as CBS celebrated the 30th anniversary of "Judge Judy" with the primetime special "Judge Judy: Unfiltered, Unforgettable." The TV icon also addressed the growing nostalgia for an earlier era, suggesting that many people are craving elements of the 1950s — including a greater sense of order, personal responsibility and common decency. "They long for a time when people respected each other." They can't even talk to each other with civility." Sheindlin previously described the appeal of her courtroom shows as a reflection of what viewers want in their own lives. "They like rules, law, order, and personal responsibility." "They like their neighbors to be nice and quiet, to keep their cats on their own property," she added. "There are reasons for bad behavior, but there are never excuses for bad behavior if it affects someone else." The original "Judge Judy" premiered in 1996 and ran for 25 seasons before ending in 2021. Sheindlin later launched "Judy Justice," which is set to conclude in October. articles.title: Maine lobsterman catches ultra-rare cotton candy lobster with crazy odds: 'It just glowed'
articles.summary: Bill Kirby's crew pulled a one-in-100-million cotton candy lobster from a trap off Searsport, Maine, and its glow stopped everyone on the boat.
articles.body: A lobsterman and his crew in Searsport, Maine had an experience they won't soon forget. That's because they caught a "cotton candy" lobster, a rare find with estimated odds at one in 100 million. Bill Kirby, the owner of Kirby's Lobster Shack who WMTV reports has more than four decades under his belt, and his crew hauled in the rare lobster last Wednesday during what was a routine day. If you ask Kirby, he couldn’t do what he does "without a good crew." He and that good crew were doing what they normally do when they're catching lobsters. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS "It was a normal day of hauling and going along, and it was a nice day out, too. We were just talking and going about our regular business. And that first trap that came up, when he swung it around — it had other lobsters in it as well — and that one was just like there was a light on," Kirby said. "It just glowed, you know." That glow, not that I'm a marine crustacean expert or anything, is caused by a genetic color mutation. After noticing it, he then turned his attention to making sure the lobster made it back to land safely. "First thing I did, once he opened it up, I went over and grabbed a hold of it and I wanted to take a look at it and found out that it was a keeper, and it was almost like we were trying to protect it the rest of the time," he said. 'WORST AQUARIUM EVER' REVIEW SENDS WHALING MUSEUM'S SALES SOARING 250% "I just wanted to get it back and put it in the tanks. That way, other people have a chance to experience it as well." Obviously, when Kirby tossed it into the tank alongside the other lobsters, it stood out. It's a cotton candy lobster and the others are just lobster lobsters. For those thinking he's planning to sell the lobster to the highest bidder, you're wrong. Kirby told the local outlet that he plans to donate it to the Oceanarium and Education Center in Bar Harbor. And it’s not just to see lobsters like that, but it's to keep the industry going for our kids. We have to protect it," Kirby said. "Us as fishermen, we’re the ones that have to make it work. We have to look out for it. That way, our kids, if they want to fish or they choose to, or other people’s children, they’ll have an opportunity to come out here and do the same thing I do every day." articles.title: Best hikes in and around Knoxville ahead of Tennessee's showdown with Texas Longhorns
articles.summary: Ijams Nature Center, House Mountain, and Sharp's Ridge top the list of must-hike Knoxville trails to explore during a fall college football weekend.
articles.body: Fall is officially here, which means hiking season is about to reach its peak. Hiking in the summer is fine and all, but autumn hikes feature perfect temperatures, fall colors, and crisp air that will have you remembering your treks for years to come. And what better way to kick off the true start to hiking season than a top-15 college football showdown in east Tennessee. BEST HIKES IN AND AROUND OXFORD TO GET YOU READY FOR OLE MISS-LSU'S WEEK THREE SHOWDOWN With all due respect to college towns like Oxford and Lubbock, they have nothing on Knoxville when it comes to getting a true hike in. Being able to pick trails around the University of Tennessee and its surrounding areas is almost like cheating, so if you're heading to Neyland for the game this weekend, you owe it to yourself to check out a few of these spots. Ijams Nature Center The best overall hike in the Knoxville area has to belong to the Ijams Nature Center. Whether you're in town early or you have only a couple hours on Saturday morning before kickoff, this is the hike for you. HIKING ETIQUETTE RULES THAT SHOULD BE COMMON SENSE BUT APPARENTLY NEED TO BE SPELLED OUT FOR SOME PEOPLE Situated just three miles from downtown, Ijams Nature Center features more than 14 miles of hikeable trails across forests, meadows, ponds and an old quarry landscape, with routes ranging from easy to difficult. I highly recommend checking out Mead's Quarry, which has several trails that weave through a former industrial landscape around a gorgeous quarry lake. If you're looking for a nice, relaxing hike, you can also check out the River Boardwalk, which features stunning views of the Tennessee River. There's something for everyone here and you don't even need to leave the city. House Mountain While Ijams is the more versatile pick, if you're looking for the best "pure hike," House Mountain is the place to be. The House Mountain State Natural Area is about 15 miles northeast of the city, and it gives hikers both a workout and a view for their efforts. Seriously, this is the highest point in Knox county, featuring a 2,100-foot crest for those of you who are looking to actually climb something while you're in the Volunteer State. Readers beware: this is an actual hike, not just a leisurely stroll around a greenway, so pack accordingly. COLLEGE FOOTBALL'S FIRST FULL SATURDAY IS HERE AND IT'S A CELEBRATION OF AMERICA AT ITS BEST We're talking wooded areas leading to rocky overlooks, but the payoff of the breathtaking views of the Cumberland and Unaka Mountains is well worth it. The burning in your calves will be temporary, but the pictures from the summit will last a lifetime. Sharp's Ridge Veterans Memorial Park When I said Knoxville was basically a cheat code when it came to hiking spots, I wasn't lying, and Sharp's Ridge Veterans Memorial Park is a perfect example of why. It's less than a 10-minute drive from the downtown area, meaning the views of both the Knoxville skyline and the Smokey Mountains are insane. Sharp's Ridge features nearly five and a half miles of trails, and the observation deck at the top with the aforementioned views is the reward for getting the job done. The observation deck even has signage pointing out the names of the different mountains in the distance. This is well worth your time, and it's just a short drive from where you are likely staying, meaning there's no excuse to miss out on this hike. You can see the Smokies without ever having to go out of your way, so check it out while you're in Knoxville. William Hastie Natural Area So, you're looking for a picturesque hike without being inundated by tourists? William Hastie Natural Area is the choice. Consider this Knoxville's "hidden gem," as this hilly and wooded trail to the south of the city is the one only locals know about. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The natural-surface trails weave through miles of heavily forested terrain, and it has hikes that will satisfy both beginners and seasoned veterans alike. Trails like Mitchie's Way have been designed specifically with hikers in mind, meaning the whole area is optimized for those looking to just get a good hike in. No frills, but definitely not bare bones either.
